roleTitle: Senior UX Researcher — AEC Foundation Model

job.rawJd: Job Title: UX Researcher. Contract Length: 6+ months. Location: 100% remote. Pay Range: $60/hr to $68/hr on W2. Looking for a User Researcher/UX Researcher with expertise writing surveys, running usability testing and reviews, setting up measurement frameworks, and helping teams improve. Quantitative and qualitative research are both needed. Less AEC experience is acceptable with experience working with doctors, engineers, lawyers, or similar expert users. Experience identifying opportunities with AI is needed. AutoCAD, Revit, or Forma is nice to have. Qualtrics or similar survey software is required. The researcher should bring human-centric, empathetic, and ethical thinking. Top skills: measurement frameworks are most important; measurement tools for AI tools or LLMs are a plus; AEC or construction domain experience, or work with doctors, construction engineers, lawyers, or similar experts; and Qualtrics or similar survey software. The Senior UX Researcher will help shape an industry-defining Foundation Model for architecture, engineering, and construction. The role works at the intersection of ML systems and human-centered design, evaluating model behavior against real user experience, building rigorous measurement infrastructure, and ensuring insights travel across teams. This is a high-autonomy role spanning multiple initiatives, organizational complexity, evolving AI products, and synthesis into coherent product direction. Research execution includes designing, conducting, and analyzing qualitative and quantitative studies across the full product lifecycle, with strong emphasis on post-release validation of high-fidelity features. Methods include contextual inquiry, usability studies, surveys, participatory design workshops, analytics, and customer advisory councils. AI and model evaluation includes evaluating AI model outputs and behavior against UX goals and building, owning, and iterating measurement protocols for live and in-flight features. Collaboration includes delivering insights to designers, engineers, product managers, ML researchers, and senior leadership; leading design-thinking and visioning workshops; and evangelizing research through presentations, internal posts, workshops, and other empathy-building formats. Requirements include five-plus years of user research embedded in a product or design organization, leading cross-functional research projects, managing multiple research workstreams, working across time zones with distributed teams, familiarity with AEC workflows or tools such as AutoCAD or Revit as a strong plus, practical AI/ML product experience, and deep experience designing measurement frameworks and evaluating features against success criteria before and after release.

hardGates.gate: Five-plus years of research within product or design organizations
hardGates.evidence: The evidence spans healthcare UX research beginning in 2018, enterprise research leadership at Kinesso from 2020 through 2023, and current product discovery and testing work through One Block Away and Hedgehox. The positioning does not claim five years in a dedicated researcher title.
The User Research case study directly documents Typeform for feedback and result analysis. Qualtrics itself is not claimed.
Direct methods include interviews, workshops, standardized synthesis, Typeform feedback, Useberry prototype testing, Heap product-behavior analytics, and benchmark-driven digital audits.

hardGates.evidence: The posting explicitly accepts experience with doctors and other expert users in place of AEC. The resume documents research and UX work for healthcare professionals, patients, regulated pharma teams, and legal-medical review stakeholders.
